basis: Place-nodes demo probes (2026-11-18): four standard books on Sri Lanka and Saskatchewan show no author because the book is an unkeyed node and its LC main-entry author has no person key (the 2026-11-10 two-layer rule mints a cited work's author only with an LC authority and 2+ citing theses). Class count in unlinked-lc-authors.json: of 487,906 graph books with an LC place heading, 139,489 have no AUTHORED/EDITED row; 120,188 of them have an LC 100 main entry; 95,400 resolve to an LC authority that is on no person key (82,902 distinct authorities), 79 to an authority on one key (credits the LC catalogue route should make), 24,709 do not resolve to one authority. NOT APPLIED: a proposal for the user. The general fix is the user's call: mint people from LC main entries of books with a place heading (82,902 authorities, mostly not historians), or show the LC main-entry name on unkeyed books as an unlinked printed author on place pages without minting.
